title: Don't change DOM nodes React manages

slides.say: Refs give you DOM nodes. Focusing and scrolling them is safe. Changing them is risky.
Here a paragraph is shown with state. Remove it with the DOM API, then toggle the state again, and the app crashes. React no longer knows how to manage that DOM.

slides.text: Modifying, adding or removing children of React-managed nodes → glitches or crashes.
slides.say: Modifying, adding children to, or removing elements that React manages can cause inconsistent results or crashes.

slides.code:
// ✅ React never touches its children
<div ref={mapRef} />
slides.say: You can safely change parts React has no reason to update, like the children of a div that is always empty in your JSX.
